name: Kasumi Jikkenshitsu
source:
To rescue Hayate, Kasumi and Ayane infiltrate D*ATEC.
However, it turns out to be false information planted by the enemy.
Finally captured, the two are injected with a mysterious new drug.
And so, Kasumi and Ayane become guinea pigs for experimentation...

[Translated from [url=http://vmax2.sakura.ne.jp/kasumi_j.html]the official website[/url]]
